redfin.remarks: 16858 Weddington — Timeless Charm, Prime Location & Opportunity. On the market for the first time in 26 years, this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a wonderful combination of character, comfort, and potential. Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac , the property welcomes you with the warmth and character that make a house feel like home. Inside, original oak floors add timeless appeal and beautiful natural character throughout the living areas. The home has been thoughtfully maintained and features all-copper plumbing , a tankless water heater , and solar with an approximately $50/month payment. For those looking to expand or create additional value, the property offers ADU potential to the right of the garage. This presents an exciting opportunity for a guest house, home office, rental, or additional living space (subject to applicable approvals). The location is equally appealing. Situated south of the 101, the home offers convenient access to the 405 Freeway and Ventura Boulevard, while being close to the shopping, dining, parks, and everyday amenities of Sherman Oaks, Encino, and the surrounding Valley communities. A rare opportunity to own a home with original charm, valuable updates, expansion potential, and a highly convenient location—all offered to the market for the first time in over two decades.
